source_units: FBX cm, model scale100 => mesh coordinate is metre
dimension_note: 0.7m is a configured simulation scale, not a measurement of a physical cone.
local_axes: X,Y on ground; +Z upward; origin at original central ground plane
symmetry: Approximate C4; cyclic corner permutations only, no reflections.
symmetry_note: The source has sub-mm unequal base axes and an off-axis tip (~2mm). All four yaw candidates remain ambiguous. Small reprojection differences must not be interpreted as absolute-yaw observability.
anchor_definition: Tip: highest original mesh vertex. Base: original ground-plane vertex maximizing +/-X+/-Y, four cyclic corners. No BBox-derived or hand-placed labels.
